name: TypeScript SQLite
description: Exercise SQLite migrations, transaction rollback, and a durable local job queue using Drizzle and better-sqlite3.

execution.network: Offline synthetic fixtures. Loopback-only HTTP where required; no external credentials or model inference.
execution.smokeCommand: node --input-type=module -e "await import('drizzle-orm/better-sqlite3')" && node /opt/render/runtime/node-recipe.mjs smoke typescript-sqlite sqlite-migration-workbench
